|       |-- Queue command -> browser long-poll -> registered handler -> HTTP reply
|       |   `-- Reply must match pending command ID and canvas ID to settle dispatch
|       |-- [O] Browser hook owns ephemeral canvasId, polling and a bounded command-result cache
|       |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and requests unregister; pagehide also requests unregister
|       `-- [O] Bridge owns registrations, queues, pending promises and timers
|           |-- Reply or timeout releases pending dispatch; timeout leaves outcome uncertain
|           `-- Registration retirement/unregister wakes pollers and rejects pending commands
|-- Execute semantic operations and recover uncertain acknowledgements
|   |-- [C] exec(code) -> QuickJsAgentRuntime -> validated host invocation
|   |   |-- Script sees frozen canvas, nodes and edges APIs
|   |   `-- [O] Each run gets a bounded QuickJS context; finally disposes it on success or failure

|   |   |-- Caller expectedVersion must equal the execution's initial document version
|   |   |-- Acknowledged writes advance the tracked version used by subsequent writes
|   |   `-- Source-mapping replacement also obtains the current diagram's ASCII content hash
|   |-- [C] Dispatch by attachment and execution mode
|   |   |-- Live document -> browser bridge above; proposal document -> ChangeSessionService.apply
|   |   |-- Immediate mode -> apply one operation -> return its result
|   |   `-- Batched mode -> retain operations; return queued IDs for dependent writes
|   |       `-- Read/barrier or successful script completion -> flush -> mutation receipts
|   |           `-- A queued ID identifies intended work; acknowledgement establishes its result
|   `-- Recovery: retry identical arguments with the same scoped requestId
|       |-- Tool requests: scope includes access mode, tool, attachment and proposal
|       |   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService retains signature + promise; changed input conflicts
|       |   `-- Recognized timeout/reply failures release the request entry to permit recovery
|       |-- Exec retry: retained run fixes API-step order, operation IDs and expected versions
|       |   |-- Rerun script -> replay completed API outcomes -> resend unacknowledged work
|       |   |-- Changed step signature or batch membership -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       |   |-- Catching a transport error in the script cannot turn uncertain work into success
|       |   `-- Success or non-transport failure releases run state; pure-read results are not retained
|       `-- Live copy/paste: a separate receipt scope is workspace + document + epoch + requestId
|           |-- LiveCanvasService retains command identity and result across timeout and retry

|           |   `-- Successful reply must match that nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
|           `-- Receipts are instance-owned and never evicted; capacity exhaustion rejects new work

|   |-- [M] /api/mapping/live first frame selects browser publisher or external reader

|-- Compact anchor identity across API boundaries
